meta.title: Mapped insights — V, G, θ presentations
meta.stance: A name introduces structure. It does not uncover essence. This file is a map.

rules: Nouns compress; compression is not ontology.
A name that does not change V, G, or θ is a comment.
Same word on two knobs is two operators.
Agreement on a small V is not portable; grow V to distinguish.
If an op leaves V that is θ, not a new inhabitant.
Do not add an inhabitant until you name the slot it corrects.
Claims need a falsifier. Tier is computed.
FORCED-on-cut does not lift to an unlistable alphabet.
isolate is unpriced. Results sit downstream of a paid cut.
Infinity and extra circles are the same promotion: θ dressed as V.
Frame ≠ tic. View must not write V_game.

insights.claim: Every formal system here is a choice of V, G, θ. P/G→Q is constant.
insights.receipt: 85 library carriers + project presentations parse as those three knobs.
